Shuru aur ant

Shabd, saral bhasha mein

Kitaab mein sikhaaye gaye har shabd ka matlab, alphabet ke kram mein, us chapter ke saath jahan woh pehli baar samjhaya gaya. Kul 236 shabd.

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW

A

A/B test
kisi badlaav ko users ke ek random aadhe hisse ko dikhana aur unhe baaki aadhe se compare karna; random karna hi aapko yeh kehne deta hai ki badlaav ne farq paida kiya Chapter 44
AARRR
growth ke paanch stages, har ek ko ek ginne layak event diya gaya: acquisition, activation, retention, referral aur revenue Chapter 43
abstention
system ka jawaab na dene ka faisla karna, aur yeh saaf kehna, jab uske paas evidence nahi hai; yeh product behaviour hai jise design karna padta hai, instruction mein likha ek sentence nahi Chapter 35
acceptance criteria
woh shartein jo kaam ke ek tukde ko "ho gaya" maane jaane ke liye poori karni hoti hain, har ek aise likhi gayi ki jaanchi ja sake Chapter 7
access control
rules jo tay karte hain ki kaun sa user kaun sa document ya chunk dekh sakta hai, jo application aur data layer mein lagu hote hain, model ke bharose nahi chhode jaate Chapter 35
activation moment
woh pehli baar jab user ko woh value milti hai jiska product waada karta hai; usse pehle ka sab kuch user ke liye cost hai Chapter 43
agentic search
model ko khud kai searches chalane dena, jo wapas aaye use padhne dena aur apna query dobara likhne dena, ek loop ke zariye Chapter 23
AI agent
ek model, functions ka ek set jo woh maang sakta hai, ek loop, aur kab rukna hai uska ek rule Chapter 20
AI value chain
un layers ka silsila jin par ek AI product bana hota hai: infrastructure, models, tooling aur sabse upar woh applications jo log use karte hain; har layer ka advantage kisi alag cheez se aata hai Chapter 31
allowlist
un cheezon ki list jo system ko karne ki ijaazat hai, aur jo list mein nahi hai woh mana hai Chapter 45
answer key
guard ka test set: har example sentence ke liye theek-theek yeh ki kya milna chahiye aur uske saath kya hona chahiye, jo numbered versions mein rakha jaata hai Chapter 12
API
ek program ka doosre program se ek tay format mein kuch maangne ka tareeka, jaise counter ke aar-paar thamayi gayi order slip Chapter 9
API key
ek lamba secret code jo provider ko batata hai ki kaun maang raha hai, aur bill kise bhejna hai; jiske paas yeh hai woh aapka paisa kharch kar sakta hai Chapter 9
architecture decision record
kisi bade technical decision par ek chhota note: alternatives, jo chuna gaya, saboot, nateeje, aur kya hone par aap use dobara dekhenge Chapter 40
attack surface
woh saari jagahein jahan koi bahar wala system mein kuch daal sakta hai, ya system jo kuch kar sakta hai usse chhu sakta hai; har tool, input aur connection ise badhata hai Chapter 39
attention
transformer ka woh hissa jo har token ke liye tay karta hai ki agla kya aayega yeh andaaza lagane ke liye baaki kaun se tokens sabse zyada maayne rakhte hain Chapter 8
audit trail
kaam se alag rakha gaya record ki kisne kya kiya, kab, kis rule ke tahat aur kis result ke saath, itna ki koi incident ko dobara jod kar samajh sake Chapter 39

B

B2B
business to business: aisa product jo companies ko becha jaata hai, jahan paisa dene wala aksar wahi insaan nahi hota jo use chalata hai Chapter 2
B2C
business to consumer: aisa product jo ek-ek insaan ko becha jaata hai, jo khareedne wale bhi hain aur istemaal karne wale bhi Chapter 2
bottom-up estimate
aisa size ka andaaza jo aise customers se banta hai jinhe aap gin sakte hain, aur har ek kitna dega usse guna kiya jaata hai, kisi industry report ka ek tukda lekar nahi Chapter 4
bounded agent
aisa AI agent jise steps, time aur cost par hard limits di gayi hon, ek state jo woh saaf-saaf rakhta hai, aur ek "cannot resolve" ending, taaki woh hamesha ruke Chapter 36

C

caching
provider se request ka processed start yaad rakhwana, taaki agli baar woh start bilkul same ho toh baad ki request sasti aur tez ho Chapter 21
canary release
kisi badlaav ko pehle users ke ek chhote hisse ko dikhana, purana version taiyaar rakhkar, sabko dene se pehle Chapter 38
cascade
aisa design jo har request ko sabse sasti cheez ke paas bhejta hai jo kaam kar sakti hai, aur sirf unhe agle, mehnge step par bhejta hai jo check mein fail ho jaate hain Chapter 26
case study
ek project ka ek ya do page ka bayaan: problem aur uska saboot, aapke decisions aur woh options jo aapne reject kiye, trade-offs, numbers ke saath results, jo fail hua, aur aap aage kya karte Chapter 47
changelog
har release mein kya badla, iski chhoti public list, jo users ke liye practical shabdon mein likhi gayi ho Chapter 46
chunk
kisi lambe document ka ek tukda, itna chhota ki use akele store kiya jaa sake aur bheja jaa sake Chapter 14
chunking
lambe documents ko chunks mein todna, yaani yeh tay karna ki kahan kaatna hai Chapter 14
claim audit
AI ke likhe summary se das claims uthana aur har ek ko uske source se check karna, har ek ko supported, partly supported ya unsupported mark karte hue Chapter 45
classifier
ek program jo har input ko pehle se tay categories mein se kisi ek mein daalta hai, jaise PAN, Aadhaar, mobile number ya inmein se koi nahi Chapter 13
code check
aam code ki kuch lines jo jawaab ki ek cheez ko apne aap test karti hain, jaise kya quote kiya hua phrase sach mein message mein hai; har badlaav par chalana free hai Chapter 25
cohort
users ka ek group jisne ek hi period mein shuru kiya, aur jise saath-saath time ke saath follow kiya jaata hai Chapter 44
compaction
lambi conversation ko chhota karna: beech ka hissa summary mein badal dena, aur shuruaat aur ant ko jyon ka tyon rakhna Chapter 21
competitor teardown
har alternative ko saath-saath rakh kar dekhna: woh kiske liye hai, kitne ka hai, kahan mazboot hai, aur kahan customers shikayat karte hain Chapter 4
context engineering
yeh tay karna ki har request mein kya jaayega, kis order mein jaayega, aur kya bahar rahega: instructions, examples, evidence, history aur tool results Chapter 21
context judge
guard ka teesra hissa: yeh un chhote sentences ko padhta hai jinhe pehle do hisse tay nahi kar paaye, aur decide karta hai ki woh kisi insaan ki taraf ishaara karte hain ya nahi Chapter 7
context window
ek baar mein model kitna text le sakta hai, uski limit, jismein aap jo bhejte hain aur jo woh wapas likhta hai, dono gine jaate hain Chapter 8
contextual retrieval
har chunk ko store karne se pehle usme ek sentence jodna jo bataye ki woh apne document mein kahan baitha hai, taaki akela chhoda gaya chunk apna matlab na khoye Chapter 23
contribution margin
jo costs customer ke saath badhte hain, unke baad customer aapke paas kitna chhodta hai, jo woh deta hai uske share ke roop mein Chapter 42
conversation history
chat ke pichhle messages, jinhe app ko har naye message ke saath dobara bhejna padta hai, agar woh chahta hai ki model ko sab yaad lage Chapter 10
cost of delay
jo aap har us hafte khote hain jab tak koi option intezaar karta hai Chapter 5

D

dark pattern
aisa design jo users ko apne hi khilaaf kaam karne par dhokhe se majboor kare, jaise pehle se tick kiya box, jhoothi kami ya chhupa hua cancellation Chapter 43
data contract
woh bina kahe maani hui baatein jo system ka ek hissa us data ke baare mein maan leta hai jo use milta hai, jaise ki field maujood hogi aur list khaali nahi hogi Chapter 33
data residency
woh desh ya region jahan provider aapka bheja hua text store aur process karta hai Chapter 28
decision log
ek chalta hua page jismein aap har zaroori decision likhte hain, uske peeche ka saboot likhte hain, aur yeh bhi ki kya hone par aap apna mind badal denge Chapter 1
decision memo
ek chhota document jo is tarah likha jaata hai ki vyast insaan uska pehla paragraph padh kar decision le sake Chapter 6
deletion drill
maan lena ki ek customer ne apna data delete karne ko kaha hai, aur phir woh har jagah dhoondhna jahan uska data rehta hai, taaki pata chale ki kin jagahon tak aap pahunch nahi sakte Chapter 29
delivery
product banane ka woh hissa jahan aap use achhe se banate hain: plan, specification, code, quality Chapter 2
dependency
koi bhi cheez jo aapko khatam karne ke liye apni team ke bahar se chahiye: doosri team ka kaam, supplier, data ka access, koi approval Chapter 6
design partner
ek early user jo ek adhoore product ko use karne aur aapko imaandaari se bataane par raazi ho ki use kya mila, kisi seedhi, fair cheez ke badle mein Chapter 46
diagnosis
strategy ka pehla hissa: challenge asal mein kya hai, iska imaandaar account, yeh kehne se pehle ki uske baare mein kya karna hai Chapter 5
discovery
product banane ka woh hissa jahan aap pata lagate hain ki problem asli hai ya nahi, aur hal karne layak hai ya nahi Chapter 2
distribution
product banane ka woh hissa jahan log use dhoondhte hain, try karte hain aur istemaal karte rehte hain Chapter 2
document audit
kuch banane se pehle, ek random sample se ginna ki collection ka kitna hissa saaf digital text hai, kitna scan hai, aur kitne mein matlab tables aur layout mein chhupa hai Chapter 27
DPDP Act
India ka Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, jo personal data sambhalne wali organisations ke liye duties tay karta hai, aur woh data dhoondhne aur chhupane se kahin zyada hain Chapter 29

E

edge case
ek anokha input ya situation jo woh cheezein tod deta hai jinhe aam cases kabhi chhoote nahi Chapter 7
embedding
numbers ki ek lambi list jo kisi text ko meanings ke map par ek jagah de deti hai, taaki milte-julte matlab wale texts ke numbers bhi milte-julte hon, chaahe unme ek bhi word common na ho Chapter 16
environment variable
code ke bahar, us jagah rakhi hui value jahan program chalta hai; passwords aur API keys isi jagah rakhi jaati hain Chapter 33
error analysis
100 asli outputs padhna, har ek mein kya galat hua yeh apne words mein likhna, notes ko group karna, groups ko naam dena aur unhe ginna Chapter 25
event taxonomy
un events ki list jo product record karta hai, ek naming rule ke saath jise sab follow karein, jaise object_action, lower case mein aur past tense mein Chapter 44
evidence pack
woh set jisse koi aur aapke claims check kar sake, sirf bharosa na kare Chapter 41
exit cost
ek provider ko chhodkar doosre par jaane mein paise, time aur risk mein kitna lagega; ek vendor quality mein jeet sakta hai aur phir bhi aapko saalon ke liye baandh sakta hai Chapter 40
experiment runner
ek dobara use hone wala program jo har experiment ke liye inputs, outputs, settings, timings aur errors record karta hai, taaki result dohraya aur compare kiya ja sake Chapter 33

F

failure class
failure ki ek kisam, kisi ek failure ka instance nahi; isi se das tests ka matlab banta hai, das kahaniyon ka nahi Chapter 41
failure threshold
woh result, pilot shuru hone se pehle likha hua, jisse neeche aap use failure kahenge Chapter 32
feasibility
kya team sach mein use bana sakti hai, jitna time, skills, data aur paisa uske paas hai usmein Chapter 2
feature flag
chalte hue system mein ek switch jo ek badlaav ko kuch users ke liye on aur baaki ke liye off karta hai, bina nayi release ke Chapter 45
findings document
kya toota, uska saboot, root cause, fix, aur jaan-boojhkar kya unsolved chhoda gaya, iska saada aur factual record; brochure ka ulta Chapter 41
fine-tuning
model ko aapke apne examples par aur train karna, taaki woh ek jaise tareeke se behave kare; yeh behaviour sikhata hai, facts nahi Chapter 31
five whys
har jawaab par baar-baar "kyun?" poochhna, taaki symptom se uski wajahon tak pahunchein Chapter 3
fixed workflow
pehle se tay steps ka ek sequence, jo code mein likha hota hai, aur model sirf un steps mein use hota hai jinhe judgement chahiye Chapter 36
flywheel
ek loop jisme product use karne se product behtar hota hai, jo aur zyada use laata hai; workflow wala kisam aksar sabse mazboot hota hai Chapter 42
Fogg behaviour model
yeh idea ki koi behaviour tab hota hai jab motivation, ability aur prompt ek hi pal mein milte hain; agar nahi ho raha, toh in teeno ko ulte order mein check kijiye Chapter 43

G

generative AI
aisa AI jo naya content banata hai, jaise text, images ya code, sirf ek label ya number dene ke bajaye Chapter 8
Git
ek tool jo aapke kaam ka har version save karta hai, taaki aap dekh sakein ki kya badla aur kisi bhi purane version par wapas ja sakein Chapter 33
golden dataset
cases ka versioned aur representative set, expected behaviour ke saath, jo tay karta hai ki ek system ke liye "achha" ka matlab kya hai; ise version number chahiye, taaki result dobara chalaya ja sake Chapter 38
graceful degradation
jab system ka koi hissa fail ho, toh poora fail hone ke bajaye chhote lekin safe tareeke se chalte rehna Chapter 40
gross margin
revenue minus product deliver karne ka direct cost; AI products mein is cost ka bada hissa aksar model ya hosting ka bill hota hai Chapter 42
grounded answer
woh jawaab jo system ke diye gaye saboot se likha gaya ho aur usi tak wapas jodha ja sake, na ki us se jo model ko apne aap yaad ho Chapter 18
growth loop
ek cycle jisme ek user ke actions agle user ko laate hain, taaki output wapas input ban jaye Chapter 43
guardrail metric
aisa number jo key results ke peeche bhaagte hue kharab nahi hona chahiye Chapter 6
guiding policy
strategy ka doosra hissa: challenge ke liye aapka poora tareeka, jismein woh bhi shaamil hai jo aap karne se mana karenge Chapter 5

H

hallucination
ek aisa jawaab jo poore confidence se, saaf-suthre tareeke se diya gaya ho, lekin gadha hua ho; aisa isliye hota hai ki model likely text predict karta hai, aur "mujhe nahi pata" aksar sabse likely text nahi hota Chapter 11
harness
model ke aas-paas ki woh sab cheezein jo use product banati hain: woh code jo uska context banata hai, uske tools chalata hai, state rakhta hai, rules lagata hai, quality check karta hai aur record karta hai ki kya hua Chapter 45
HTTP
rules ka woh set jisse programs internet par requests aur replies bhejte hain, har reply par ek number ke saath jo batata hai ki kaam hua ya nahi Chapter 33
human oversight
ek insaan jo output ke peeche ka saboot dekh sakta hai aur use reject kar sakta hai; outputs ko bas guzarte dekhna isme nahi ginta Chapter 29
hybrid pricing
ek platform fee jisme kuch usage shamil ho, aur uske upar jo jaaye uska alag charge; buyer ke liye predictable aur aapke margin ki hifaazat karne wala Chapter 42
hybrid search
keyword search aur meaning wali search ko saath chalana aur dono ki rankings ko jod dena, taaki aapko dono mein se ek chunna na pade Chapter 23

I

idempotency
kisi action ki woh khoobi ki use do baar chalana safe hai, ya use aise protect kiya gaya hai ki do baar chalne ka sirf ek hi asar ho; yeh tay karti hai ki retry safe hai ya nahi Chapter 36
incident review
kuch galat hone ke baad likha gaya ek chhota writeup ki kya hua, kyun hua, aur kaun sa check use pakad leta Chapter 45
inference
taiyaar model ko kisi request ka jawaab dene ke liye chalana; har baar paisa lagta hai aur model badalta nahi Chapter 8
informed consent
kisi insaan ki haan, jo use saaf-saaf bataane ke baad di gayi ho ki kya collect hota hai, kahan jaata hai, kya galat ho sakta hai aur wapas kaise liya jaye Chapter 46
ingestion
documents ko system mein padhne ka step, jisme unhe scan karna, parse karna aur tukdon mein todna shamil hai; yahan jo kuch kho gaya, woh hamesha ke liye kho gaya Chapter 35
input metric
aisa number jise team seedha badal sakti hai aur jisse aap umeed karte hain ki outcome hilega Chapter 6
instruction tuning
model banane ka doosra stage, jismein use instructions aur achhe jawaabon ke jodon par train kiya jaata hai taaki woh instructions maane Chapter 8

J

job to be done
woh progress jo ek insaan apni zindagi mein karna chahta hai, aur jiske liye woh kisi product ko "kaam par rakhta" hai Chapter 3
JSON
information ko curly braces ke andar labels aur values ki tarah likhne ka saadha tareeka, jo lagbhag har API use karti hai Chapter 9

K

key result
ek objective ke neeche ke teen-chaar numbers mein se ek jo dikhata hai ki aap wahan pahunche ya nahi; woh naapta hai ki logon ke liye kya badla, yeh nahi ki aapne kya ship kiya Chapter 6
keyword search
text dhoondhne ka woh tareeka jisme sawaal ke words ko documents ke words se milaya jaata hai; woh spelling compare karta hai, matlab nahi Chapter 15
kill criterion
pehle se likhi hui ek shart, jiske poora hone ka matlab hai ki aap kaam rok dete hain Chapter 6
kill switch
ek flag jo traffic ko turant ek saade non-AI raaste par bhej deta hai, bina nayi deployment ke; yeh tabhi chalta hai jab woh raasta maujood ho aur haal hi mein test hua ho Chapter 30

L

language model
ek program jisne bahut saare likhe hue text se seekha hai ki aage kaun sa text aayega, iska andaaza lagana; chatbot ke peeche yahi baitha hota hai Chapter 8
latency
poochhne aur jawaab milne ke beech ka time, jise user speed ki tarah mehsoos karta hai Chapter 22
latency budget
woh total time jo ek request le sakti hai, jise un stages mein baant diya jaata hai jinse woh guzarti hai, taaki sabse dheema stage pakda jaye aur uska ek owner ho Chapter 40
leaderboard
models ki ek published ranking, jo kisi aur ke tests par unke scores se bani hoti hai Chapter 34
leading question
aisa sawaal jo poochhne wale ke man ka jawaab hi saamne wale ke munh mein daal deta hai Chapter 3
least privilege
system ko sirf utna access dena jitna use sach mein chahiye, taaki agar use dhokha diya jaye toh nuksaan chhota rahe Chapter 39
lethal trifecta
teen cheezein jo saath milkar system ko khatarnaak banati hain: private data tak pahunch, aise text se saamna jo bahar ke log likh sakte hain, aur kuch bahar bhejne ka raasta Chapter 24
LLM judge
ek model jo doosre model ke output ko grade karta hai; sasta aur tez hai, lekin uske biases hote hain aur use apni grading ke saamne check kiye bina bharosa nahi karna chahiye Chapter 25
lock-in
ek hi provider se bandh jaana, kyunki chhodna bahut mehnga padega: dobara likhna, dobara naapna, ya features kho dena Chapter 31

M

mask
kisi detail ka ek hissa chhupana par uski shape rakhna, jaise 98******12 Chapter 7
MCP
Model Context Protocol: AI applications ko tools aur data se jodne ka ek standard, jisse koi bhi compliant tool kisi bhi compliant application mein lag jaata hai, plug aur socket ki tarah Chapter 36
metadata filtering
kisi bhi scoring se pehle, un chunks ko hata dena jo sahi ho hi nahi sakte, unpar lage labels ke zariye jaise version, dates aur kaun dekh sakta hai Chapter 23
minimum detectable effect
sabse chhota badlaav jise pakadna kaam ka hai; yeh tay karta hai ki test ko kitne users chahiye Chapter 44
model selection card
ek chhota, versioned page jisme kaam, quality target, data, speed aur cost ki limits, try kiye gaye options, evidence aur fallback likhe hote hain, taaki reviewer dekh sake ki model kyun chuna gaya Chapter 34
MoSCoW
scope par sahmati banane ka tareeka, cheezon ko Must, Should, Could aur Won't mein baant kar Chapter 5
multimodal
sirf text nahi, balki pages, tasveerein, tables aur speech bhi lene ke kaabil; isse badal jaata hai ki evidence kise kehte hain aur use wapas kaise trace karte hain Chapter 37
must-keep list
har document ke liye woh facts jo padhne wale ko khone nahi chahiye; har summary ko isi list se check kiya jaata hai Chapter 13
MVP
minimum viable product: sabse chhoti cheez jo asli users ke saath aapke riskiest assumption ko aazmaye Chapter 7

N

name-and-place finder
guard ka doosra hissa: yeh un details ko dhoondhta hai jinki koi fixed shape nahi, jaise kisi insaan ka naam, pata ya employer Chapter 7
network effect
product ka sabke liye behtar hona jaise-jaise zyada log use karein, jo is se alag hai ki users doosre users ko laayein Chapter 43
North Star
ek sentence jo batata hai ki aapke customers ko kya value milti hai, aur ek number jo use naapta hai Chapter 5

O

observability
system ke rakhe hue records se dekh paana ki usne kya kiya aur kyun, bina andaaza lagaye Chapter 38
observation session
ek meeting jisme aap kisi ko ek asli kaam dete hain aur bina madad kiye use karte dekhte hain, har baar wahi cheezein note karte hue Chapter 46
OCR
optical character recognition: aisa software jo text ki picture ko text mein badalta hai, aam taur par kuch galtiyon ke saath Chapter 27
OKR
objectives and key results: shabdon mein likha ek goal, kuch numbers ke saath jo dikhate hain ki aap wahan pahunche Chapter 6
open-weight model
aisa model jiske weights publish kiye gaye hain, taaki aap use download karke apne computers par chala sakein, kisi aur ka model call karne ke bajaay Chapter 31
opportunity tree
ek drawing jo us result se shuru hoti hai jo aap chahte hain, interviews mein logon ne jo zaroorat batayi usmein branches banati hai, aur possible solutions par khatam hoti hai Chapter 4
orphaned chunk
woh chunk jiska document se kaat dene ke baad koi matlab nahi nikalta, kyunki woh kisi aisi cheez ki baat karta hai jo pichhle tukde mein thi Chapter 14
outcome pricing
har successful result ke liye charge karna, taaki price value ke saath chale; iske liye success ki ek tay, naapne layak definition chahiye Chapter 42

P

p95
woh time jise 100 mein se 95 requests beat kar deti hain; yeh dheemi poonchh dikhata hai jo average chhupa leta hai Chapter 38
parser
woh program jo kisi file, jaise PDF, ko text aur structure mein badalta hai; uski galtiyan uske baad ki har cheez ko dikhti hi nahi Chapter 35
pattern checker
guard ka pehla hissa: yeh un details ko dhoondhta hai jo hamesha ek hi shape ki hoti hain, jaise PAN ya mobile number, fixed rules se Chapter 7
persona
ek tarah ke user ka chhota sa description, jo sirf interviews mein jo dikha usi se banaya gaya ho Chapter 3
PII
personally identifiable information: koi bhi aisi detail jo ek asli insaan ki taraf ishaara kar sake, jaise naam, phone number ya pehchaan ka number Chapter 1
pilot

pinned version
model ka woh version jise aapne naam se tay kar diya hai, taaki provider aapko bataye bina use aapke neeche se badal na sake Chapter 30
positioning statement
ek sentence jo batata hai ki product kiske liye hai aur doosre alternatives se alag kyun hai Chapter 4
PRD
product requirements document: woh kaagaz jo batata hai ki kya banana hai aur kyun, problem aur uske saboot se shuru karke Chapter 7
pre-mortem
ek meeting jismein sab imagine karte hain ki project fail ho gaya, aur shuru hone se pehle likhte hain ki kyun Chapter 6
pre-training
model banane ka pehla aur sabse mehnga stage, jismein woh bahut saare text par agla token predict karna seekhta hai Chapter 8
precision
tool ne jitni cheezein flag ki, unmein se kitne percent asal mein wahi thi jo tool ne kaha; agar usne 100 flag ki aur 80 asli thi, toh precision 80 percent hai Chapter 17
predictive AI
aisa AI jo ek khaas kaam ke liye label ya number deta hai, jaise koi message spam hai ya nahi Chapter 8
problem statement
ek ya do sentence jo batayein ki problem kiski hai, kya hai, aur aaj unhein kya padti hai Chapter 3
product risk
un chaar cheezon mein se ek jo product ko doba sakti hain: koi use chahta nahi, koi use chala nahi sakta, use banaya nahi ja sakta, ya woh apna kharcha nahi nikaal sakta Chapter 2
product sense
ek user chunne, uski asli problem dhoondhne aur ek samajhdaar solution sujhane ki kabiliyat, jise interviewers aise sawaalon se parakhte hain jaise "busy parents ke liye ek product design kijiye" Chapter 47
product-led growth
customers aise jeetna ki users khud sign up karein aur khud value paayein, aur unmein se kuch upgrade karein; yeh tab fit hota hai jab value minutes mein dikhe aur price kam ho Chapter 43
production delta
woh list jo ek chalte prototype aur ek running service ke beech jo kuch missing hai usse banti hai, jaise identity, retries, queues, monitoring, secrets, backups aur rollback Chapter 40
project memory
code ke saath rakhi ek saadhi file, jisme project ke rules aur aadatein hoti hain, aur jo coding assistant ke har run ke shuru mein load hoti hai Chapter 45
prompt
woh text jo aap model ko bhejte hain; usmein instructions, examples, aur woh material ho sakta hai jis par model ko kaam karna hai Chapter 11
prompt injection
us material ke andar likha text jo system ko padhne ke liye diya gaya hai aur model ko instructions deta hai, jinhe model maan sakta hai kyunki woh aapke instructions ko un words se pakke taur par alag nahi kar sakta jo use padhne ko diye gaye Chapter 24
prototype
ek mota, sasta version jo asli ke bante se pehle kuch seekhne ke liye banaya jaata hai Chapter 7
provenance
is baat ka record ki koi cheez kahan se aayi, taaki ek claim ya decision ko uske source, version aur use banane wale code tak trace kiya ja sake Chapter 34
Python
woh programming language jisme zyadatar AI ka kaam likha jaata hai; ek product manager ke liye, yeh theek-theek kehne ka tareeka ki ek experiment kya karta hai Chapter 33

Q

quasi-identifier
aisi detail jo akeli nirdosh hai par doosron ke saath milkar ek insaan ki taraf ishaara kar sakti hai, jaise umar, gaon aur ek rare bimari Chapter 7

R

reasoning model
aisa model jo jawaab dene se pehle apna working likhta hai, ek tareeka try karta hai, use check karta hai, aur phir answer deta hai; us working ke paise aap har request par dete hain, aur intezaar bhi karte hain Chapter 22
recall
jitni asli cheezein dhoondhni thi, unmein se tool ne kitne percent dhoondhin; agar 100 thi aur tool ne 90 dhoondhin, toh recall 90 percent hai Chapter 17
red team
woh log jinka kaam jaan-boojhkar system par hamla karna hai, taaki uski kamzoriyan koi aur dhoondhe, usse pehle woh dhoondh lein Chapter 39
redact
kisi detail ko poori tarah hata dena, jaise use [PAN] shabd se badal kar Chapter 7
refusal
system ka saaf kehna ki woh yeh kaam nahi kar sakta, aur saath mein kisi insaan tak ka raasta dena; yeh jaanboojh kar design hota hai, qismat par nahi chhoda jaata Chapter 32
regression
aisa badlaav jo system ko us cheez mein kharab kar de jo woh pehle achhe se karta tha Chapter 38
release gate
ek automatic check jo golden dataset ko ek badlaav ke saamne chalata hai, aur agar koi bhi number apne threshold se neeche aaye toh release rok deta hai Chapter 38
repository
Git mein rakha hua woh folder jisme ek project ka saara kaam aur uski history hoti hai Chapter 33
reranking
pehle sasti tarah se bahut saare candidate tukde laana, phir ek dheemi, zyada dhyaan wali model se sawaal aur har tukda saath mein padhwana aur sabse achhe kuch ko upar rakhna Chapter 23
residual risk
controls lagne ke baad jo risk bacha rehta hai; ise likh dena chahiye, maan nahi lena chahiye ki woh khatam ho gaya Chapter 39
retention
ek provider aapka bheja hua text kitni der tak rakhta hai, jo jawaab dene mein lage time se bahut zyada ho sakta hai Chapter 28
retrieval
aapke documents ke woh tukde dhoondhne ka step jo sawaal ke liye kaam ke lagte hain Chapter 18
retrieval-augmented generation
RAG: ek design jisme system pehle aapke documents ke woh tukde dhoondhta hai jo sawaal ke liye kaam ke lagte hain, phir unhe sawaal ke saath model ko deta hai, taaki model unhi se apna jawaab likhe Chapter 18
RICE
options ko Reach guna Impact guna Confidence, bhaag Effort, se score karne ka tareeka Chapter 5
risk register
ek table jisme har risk ke saath uska owner, uska control, woh saboot ki control kaam karta hai, aur kitna risk bacha, yeh likha ho Chapter 39
risk tier
ek level, jo is se tay hota hai ki galat jawaab kitna nuksaan kar sakta hai, aur jo tay karta hai ki system ko kitna documentation, checking aur saboot chahiye; tier istemaal se tay hota hai, technology se nahi Chapter 29
riskiest assumption
woh baat jo sach honi hi chahiye taaki aapka idea chale, aur jis par aapko sabse kam yakeen hai, isliye jise sabse pehle test karna hai Chapter 3
roadmap

role matrix
ek table jisme ek taraf woh skills hain jo asli job advertisements maangte hain aur upar roles hain, aur jisme aap har skill ko apne liye proven, partly proven ya missing mark karte hain Chapter 47
rollback
code ke pichhle version par laut jaana, jiske liye nayi deployment chahiye, aur jo kaam nahi aata jab dono versions mein ek jaisi kharabi ho Chapter 30
rollback trigger
ek naapne layak condition, pehle se likhi hui, jo kisi ko release undo karne par bound karti hai Chapter 45
routing

rule-keeper
guard ka chautha hissa: yeh tay karta hai ki mili hui har detail ke saath kya karna hai, jaise hata do, mask karo, jaane do ya poochho Chapter 7

SAM

scoreboard
woh table jo tool ke har version ke liye ginta hai ki usne kya dhoondha, kya chhod diya, aur kya galti se flag kar diya Chapter 12

seat pricing

shadow AI

similarity score
lagbhag 0 se 1 ke beech ka ek number jo batata hai ki do embeddings kitni paas hain; jab tak aapko na pata ho ki bilkul achhe aur bilkul bure matches kitna score karte hain, tab tak iska matlab bahut kam hai Chapter 16
SOM
serviceable obtainable market: SAM ka woh hissa jo aap lagbhag teen saal mein sach mein jeet sakte hain Chapter 4

sprint

staging

stakeholder
koi bhi jo project ki madad ya rok kar sakta hai, ya jis par uska asar padta hai Chapter 6

apne beete hue kal ki kahani chaar hisson mein sunane ka tareeka: situation, task, action aur result, jisme zyadatar time is par jaata hai ki aapne kya kiya Chapter 47

status code

status quo
log aaj jo karte hain, kuch na karna bhi usmein shaamil; aksar sabse mazboot competitor Chapter 4
step limit

streaming
jawaab ko screen par tukdon mein bhejna, jaise-jaise woh likha ja raha hai, poora hone ka intezaar kiye bina Chapter 22
structured output

system card
AI system ka ek page ka description: woh kis kaam ke liye hai, kaun sa data use karta hai, use kaise test kiya gaya, woh kya galat karta hai, aur use kis kaam mein nahi lena chahiye Chapter 29
system prompt
woh standing instructions jo ek app har request ke saath bhejta hai, jinmein likha hota hai ki assistant kaun hai aur use kya karna hai aur kya nahi Chapter 11
system-design interview

take-home

TAM
total addressable market: woh sab log jinhe yeh problem hai, us keemat par jo aap lagayenge Chapter 4
task type

temperature
ek setting jo tay karti hai ki model kitni baar agla kam likely token chunta hai; low rakhne par har baar milte-julte jawaab aate hain, high rakhne par zyada variety Chapter 11

asli ya asli jaise examples ka ek collection, jisme har example ka sahi jawaab pehle se likha hota hai, aur jisse kisi system ko naapa jaata hai Chapter 12
time-box

time-to-value

ek plan jo request ke har hisse ko tokens ka uska share deta hai, aur jisme koi ek insaan total ka owner hota hai aur jaanta hai ki sabse pehle kya kaatna hai Chapter 21

tool description
text ki woh kuch lines jo model ko batati hain ki function kya karta hai, kya wapas deta hai aur kya nahi; model unhe padhkar function chunta hai, isliye vague description ek bug hai Chapter 20

trace record

tracking plan

transformer

usability

worked example
